subject: Nickelodeon Guts
text: The game supports 2-player play.

evidence.quote: since it did support 2 player play.

subject: Event Setups option
object: hides event name, object and scoring
text: Turning Event Setups off hides the event's name, object, and scoring.

evidence.quote:
If this option is turned off, you aren't told the name of the event, the object
of the event, or the scoring of the event.

subject: 1 Player Game
text: A one-player game is not an official game; it is training.

evidence.quote:
If only one player is playing, it is not considered an official game, rather,
you are in training.

subject: Guts Training
text: In Guts Training, you need 700 points to compete on the Aggro Crag.

evidence.quote:
If you are playing Guts: Training, you are told that you need 700 points to
compete on the Aggro Crag.

subject: Character profiles
text: Each profile has a favorite sport that may give an advantage in events featuring that sport, though this is unproven.

evidence.quote:
They all have a favorite sport, which
may give you a certain advantage in the sport that is featured in the certain
events, though that has not been proven yet.

subject: Player color
text: Choosing a player color gives no gameplay advantage.

evidence.quote: There is no advantage to any certain color, it's just a style thing.

subject: Player name
text: Player names can be up to 8 letters.

evidence.quote:
The number of letters you can enter at a maximum is 8, so use them
wisely.

subject: Slam Dunk
text: In Slam Dunk, score the most points within a 2:30 time limit; each made shot is worth 5 points.

evidence.quote:
Object: Score the most points
Scoring: Every shot you make is worth 5 points
Time Limit: 2:30
2 Player Mode Scoring: 300 points for 1st place, 100 for 2nd place

subject: Slam Dunk shot
text: In Slam Dunk, hold Down to fill the power meter, release, then press B near the basket to shoot.

evidence.quote:
Then, when you are ready, press and hold the
down button, until the power meter (on the left side of the screen), is filled
to your liking.  Release down, and then wait until you are near the basket
before pressing B to shoot the ball.

subject: Slam Dunk padding return
text: In Slam Dunk, hold Down on the way back to stay safely on the padding.

evidence.quote:
IMPORTANT!  Don't forget to hold Down on your way back.  You'll see the power
meter move up just a tad, but if you did it correctly, you'll get back up on
the padding safe and sound.

subject: Slam Dunk padding return
text: Not holding Down enough on the way back in Slam Dunk can make you stagger or stumble off the padding, costing time.

evidence.quote:
If you don't do it, or don't do it enough, you
might stagger up to the padding, or even stumble off, costing you valuable
time.

subject: Basic Training
text: In Basic Training, reach the finish line in the fastest time; each second left under the 6 minute limit is worth 1 point.

evidence.quote:
Object: Get to the finish line in the fastest time
Scoring: 1 point awarded for every second left under the 6 minute time limit
(ex: if you finish in 5:59, you get 1 point)
Time Limit: 6:00

subject: Pole or rope side switch
text: On a pole or rope, press the d-pad toward the side you are climbing to switch sides; for example, press Right to switch to the left side.

evidence.quote:
If you wish to move to the other
side of the pole/rope, simply hit the d-pad in the direction of the side you
are currently climbing up (for example, if you want to switch to the left side
of the pole/rope, simply press right, and you will switch).

subject: X button
text: Use X to jump in Basic Training.

evidence.quote: Speaking of jumping, use X to perform that feat.

subject: Up button
text: Up looks up and climbs poles and ropes.

evidence.quote:
Use Up to look up (no true use there), and to climb up poles and ropes (plenty
of use).

subject: Pole or rope climbing
text: You must be in a perfect position to grab a pole or rope, so keep trying if you cannot climb right away.

evidence.quote:
Don't get frustrated if you can't climb up right away, because you
have to be in an absolutely perfect position to get on a pole or rope.

subject: Down button
text: Down crouches, and Down with Left or Right in one fluid motion slides under obstacles, which works better than pressing Down and then moving.

evidence.quote:
Using
Down will allow you to crouch, and if you use down with left or right in a
fluid motion, you can even slide under the obstacles in this course, which is
much more effective than pressing down, and then moving left or right by

subject: Basic Training route
text: In Basic Training, follow the arrow signs; they will not mislead you.

evidence.quote:
As for a walkthrough of the event, you should basically follow the rule of
thumb of following the arrow signs.  They won't mislead you.

subject: Basic Training
text: The author's best Basic Training times were in the 4:30-4:50 range of time remaining.

evidence.quote:
My best times
have been somewhere in the 4:30-4:50 range (time remaining), so you can score
some nice points in this game.

subject: Basic Training
text: Basic Training has stopwatch pickups that add time to the clock.

evidence.quote: Items you can pick up in Basic Training:

Stopwatches (time bonus) - These little items give you more time to complete
the course, which can equal more points in the end for you.  Very helpful.

subject: Basic Training
text: Basic Training has a jumping jack man that refills the energy meter, though grabbing him is only worth it for about 5 seconds of speed.

evidence.quote:
Jumping jack man (meter refiller) - Unless you really want to run fast for
about 5 more seconds before you jump too hard and your poor little GUTS
contender loses a little chunk of his life, don't bother grabbing one of these.

subject: Energy meter
text: A full energy meter makes your character run a little faster.

evidence.quote:
It's an energy meter of sort, but only to the point that when it is full, you
run a *little* faster.  Not much.

subject: Energy meter
text: The energy meter goes down from hard landings, sliding off poles, GUTS bag hits, falling into gaps, and running into the course.

evidence.quote:
1. Landing too hard on a jump
2. Sliding off a pole (you could do it on a rope, but the pole is far more
likely)
3. Getting hit by one of the swinging GUTS bags
4. Falling down some kind of gap
5. Running into the course (truly a funny animation)

subject: Energy meter
text: The energy meter refills when you stand still or get the jumping jack man's item.

evidence.quote:
1. Just stand there and watch your character breathe
2. Get the jumping jack guy's item to refill the meter

subject: Basic Training 2-player
text: The 2-player Basic Training is different from the 1-player version.

evidence.quote: NOTE: The 2-player Basic Training is different from the one player.

subject: Spirals
text: In Spirals, score the most points; each spiral made in the hoop is worth 5 points, within a 2:30 time limit.

evidence.quote:
Object: Score the most points
Scoring: 5 points for every spiral made in the "hoop"
Time Limit: 2:30
2 Player Mode Scoring: 300 points for 1st place, 100 for 2nd place

subject: Spirals
text: In Spirals, use the Slam Dunk method: press Down to the desired point on the meter and press B at the height of your jump.

evidence.quote:
Just remember the Slam Dunk instructions,
press down to the desired point on the meter, then go along with the ride and
at the height of your jump, press B.

subject: Spirals scoring tip
text: For Spirals, go to the far right, set the power meter to the 5th notch, and release near the basket.

evidence.quote:
Need a little help scoring?  Here's a tip I have working for me.  Go to the
right as far as you can, and then push your power meter to the 5th notch, not
too much above or below that, just to be safe.  Then, when you get close to the
basket, let 'er rip.

subject: Spirals padding return
text: In Spirals, press Down on the way back to avoid falling off the padding.

evidence.quote:
Don't forget to press Down on your way back, so you don't
fall off the padding like some drunk.

subject: Tornado Run
text: In Tornado Run, reach the finish line in the fastest time; each second under the 7 minute limit is worth 1 point.

evidence.quote:
Object: Get to the finish line in the fastest time
Scoring: 1 point for every second under the time limit
Time Limit: 7:00
2 Player Mode Scoring: 300 points for 1st place, 100 for 2nd place

subject: Tornado Run
text: Tornado Run is like Basic Training but much more challenging.

evidence.quote:
And guess what, it's just like Basic Training, only a lot, lot more
challenging.

subject: Tornado Run
text: Unless you are a truly beginner, you cannot run out of time in Tornado Run.

evidence.quote:
Unless you are truly a beginner, there's no way
that you can run out of time in this event.

subject: Tornado Run controls
text: Use X to jump, Down to crouch, Left or Right to crawl while crouching or to run, and Up or Down to climb a pole or rope.

evidence.quote:
Just remember, use X to jump, down to crouch, left/right to crawl while
crouching or to run, up/down to climb up and down a pole or rope.

subject: Attack
text: In Attack, score the most points within a 2:30 time limit; each point made in the contest is worth 5 points.

evidence.quote:
Object: Score the most points
Scoring: 5 points for every point made in the contest
Time Limit: 2:30
2 Player Mode Scoring: 300 points for 1st place, 100 for 2nd place

subject: Attack
text: Attack uses the same controls as Slam Dunk and Spirals: charge the meter, press B to shoot, and press Down to return to the padding.

evidence.quote:
Same controls here, down to charge up meter, B to shoot, and down to get back
up on the padding.

subject: Attack scoring tip
text: One approach that worked for the author in Attack is to stand far right, fill the meter to max, and shoot at the top of the jump.

evidence.quote:
Something that worked for me was to get on the far right side of the padding,
hold the meter to its max, and then shoot at the very top of my jump.

subject: Aggro Crag
text: In Aggro Crag, jump on all 6 actuators in the fastest time; each second under the 7 minute limit is worth 1 point.

evidence.quote:
Object: Jump on all 6 actuators in the fastest time
Scoring: 1 point for every second under the time limit
Time Limit: 7:00

subject: Aggro Crag
text: In Aggro Crag, you must jump on the actuators; you cannot just walk over them.

evidence.quote:
Remember, you have to jump on the actuators, you can't just walk over the
actuators.

subject: Aggro Crag
text: Aggro Crag is like Basic Training and Tornado Run but even harder.

evidence.quote:
Yeah, this is the event that you've been waiting for.  However, it's just like
Basic Training and the Tornado Run, except it's even harder than both.

subject: Guts show
text: At the end of the game, whoever has the most points wins.

evidence.quote: So, at the end, whoever has the most points at the end of the game wins.

subject: Character profiles
text: There are no names for these people, but there are 6 females and 2 males.

evidence.quote:
There are no names for these people, but there are 6 females...and 2
males.

subject: Aggro Crag
text: In 2 Player Mode, Aggro Crag scoring is 725 for 1st place and 325 for 2nd place.

evidence.quote: 2 Player Mode Scoring: 725 for 1st place, 325 for 2nd
